comparator.sourceNotes: The corrected Physics and Astronomy pathway closes 60+60+60 with 90 EC compulsory study including the 15-EC bachelor research project, one 7.5-EC bound choice, five additional 7.5-EC restricted choices satisfying the 30-EC level-3 minimum, and 45 EC genuine profiling. The selected mechanics/fluid/quantum progression satisfies the published preparation signals. Formal and selected upper-course evidence support Dutch plus English.

alternatives.concept: Use calculus, linear algebra, numerical methods, probability, differential and linear-system models, programming, machine learning, imaging and remote sensing to study the Earth system, climate, water, hazards, resources and environmental change. This is the strongest related-fields response to the selected climate-physics direction; it is not Physics or Astronomy equivalence.

progressionAssessment.rationale: The schedule contains 24 unique courses, four per semester, PPD in Year 1 and six 300-level courses. Every formal prerequisite occurs earlier and every course is available in its assigned Fall 2026 cohort semester. Sustainability Essentials I precedes Sustainability Essentials II, Earth-system tools, Earth observation, biogeochemistry and Earth resources; Mathematical Methods precedes all dependent mathematics and neural-network study. Introductory Earth and sustainability work precedes the advanced environmental research and resource courses.

alternativeSelection.assessment: One complete related-fields programme passes the evidence, course-content and schedule gates. It responds to the selected climate-physics direction through mathematical modelling, scientific data and substantive Earth-system, climate, remote-sensing and environmental-research study. It is not represented as Physics and Astronomy. A fundamental/theoretical direction cannot supply mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, statistical physics, quantum theory, field theory or matter/particle depth. An astronomy direction cannot supply celestial mechanics, stellar and galactic astrophysics, cosmology, astronomical observation or instrumentation. A separate experimental-physics direction cannot supply cumulative physics laboratories, measurement instrumentation or a physics research sequence. These directions were assessed separately rather than filled with adjacent mathematics or environmental courses.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both establish calculus, matrices and differential-equation tools for quantitative science; the external course is embedded in a cumulative physics sequence.
Both develop linear mathematical structures used in physical models; UCR provides a general linear-algebra course rather than physics-specific mathematical techniques.
Both advance mathematical problem solving for natural systems; UCR focuses on numerical equations, integration and differential equations.
Both develop analysis of empirical data; UCR covers general data preparation, visualisation and research rather than physics-specific data acquisition.
Both study coupled atmosphere, ocean and climate processes; UCR approaches them through Earth-system modelling, proxies and tracers rather than a physics course in dynamical fluid equations.
Both require an empirical natural-system research project; UCR undertakes an externally partnered sustainability project rather than an experimental physics laboratory project.
